title: RB4107 MQTT payloads, schema_version 2
description: Every message the ESP32-S3 controller publishes under rb4107/#. Produced by firmware/components/rb_json. Unknown extra fields are allowed so the schema can grow (e.g. more sensors).

boot_id.description: random per controller boot; with sequence it orders messages across reboots (optional: firmware before 2026-09-30 does not send it)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with offset; null while the controller's wall clock is not set

detected.description: presence nodes with a valid reading only; null otherwise

verdict.description: radar state and distance rules (placeholder): passing = a target that has not settled at the stove, dwelling = arrived and settled there. Only presence nodes, only while the rules are on

episode_ms.description: the current (or last) episode of a target near this radar: how long it lasted

stationary_ms.description: ... how much of it as a stationary target

span_cm.description: ... the spread of the distances seen

espnow_channel.description: radio channel ESP-NOW uses now (the Wi-Fi router's on Wi-Fi)

presence_state.description: both presence nodes combined, as the safety state machine used it: with both radars, PRESENT only when every working radar sees someone (someone at the stove)

nearby.description: somebody near either radar (the earlier, looser presence)

reset_required.description: supply cut and latched until an operator reset

shutdown_after_ms.description: configured time before SHUTDOWN, counted from shutdown_counts_from

hold.description: what holds a due buzzer or shutdown back right now: return = the radar sees someone and the return is being confirmed (bounded); cooling = the pan is only cooling down (at most 4 cookware time constants); falling = the temperature is falling and the trend has not confirmed heat going in yet (at most falling_hold_max_ms per countdown)

tier.description: temperature tier in force: the hotter the pan (or the tier a rising pan is heading for), the shorter the buzzer and shutdown times. tier1 = the base times (warning_after_ms / shutdown_after_ms). normal/elevated/critical: firmware before 2026-10-31 (three tiers)

effective_warning_ms.description: the buzzer time in force now (base, tier and timing hook applied); never longer than warning_after_ms

effective_shutdown_ms.description: the shutdown time in force now, counted like shutdown_after_ms

oneOf.description: tiers 2 to 5 (tier 1 is the base times): tier N from temp_c, or when rising fast enough to reach it within its warning time (rate). Times count like the base times. A tier with temp_c <= 0 is off. Firmware before 2026-10-31 sent elevated/critical objects instead of levels

source.description: dashboard = set from the dashboard and saved on the controller

rate.description: a rising pan gets the tier it is heading for

radar_rules.description: the radar state and distance rules (a placeholder, not tuned on real data): off = not computed, observe = computed and reported but not used, enforce = a radar that only sees someone passing does not count as at the stove

paused.description: the unattended clock is stopped because someone is at the stove (until presence_return_debounce_ms of presence cancels the timeline, or the pause budget is used up)

pause_budget_ms.description: the pause budget in force on this timeline (the smaller of the configured one and its share of the shutdown time)

presence_unknown.description: flag: presence data missing/invalid. Not FAULT: with nothing cooking it starts no timer; while cooking, presence counts as absent

thermal_lost.description: flag: thermal data missing/invalid. Flag only: cooking is neither assumed nor cancelled

absent_ms.description: absence debounce progress: time since the absence began, 0 = not running. A presence blip does not reset it; only a confirmed return does

returning_ms.description: return debounce progress: time presence has been seen, 0 = not running

presence_filter.description: presence filter in use: absence needed before UNATTENDED, presence needed to cancel UNATTENDED/WARNING, absent gaps that don't restart that count. source dashboard also means warning_after_ms and shutdown_after_ms were set from the dashboard

fusion.description: someone is at the stove when every working radar sees them (all) or either does (any)

pause_budget_cfg_ms.description: the configured pause budget per timeline

pause_budget_pct.description: and at most this share of the shutdown time in force

attendance_source.description: dashboard = fusion and pause budget set from the dashboard and saved on the controller

cookware.description: cookware profile in use: sets the cooling time constant the trend is judged with. source dashboard = picked from the dashboard and saved on the controller

cooking.description: cooking temperatures in use: IDLE -> MONITORING when the hottest pixel reaches on_c, back to IDLE below off_c. source dashboard = set from the dashboard and saved on the controller

active.description: cooking detected by the thermal camera (the heat detector's state)

phase.description: from the temperature trend: heating/holding = heat is going in, cooling = heading for the room temperature, checking = not enough data yet (counts as heat going in)

rate_c_per_min.description: fitted rate of the hottest pixel over the last two minutes

settle_c.description: where the temperature is heading: T + tau * rate

params.description: every other safety setting in force, by the keys of the controller_command params action (firmware/components/rb_params/include/rb_params.def), in the same units

params_source.description: dashboard = params set from the dashboard and saved on the controller

thermal_frame_msg.description: One MLX90640 heat-map picture (display only; the safety logic never uses it). Pixel value v is base_c + v * step_c degC; the value 'invalid' means no reading. Pixels are row by row, 'width' per row.

number.description: the thermal node's picture counter; restarts when the node reboots

hot_threshold_c.description: the thermal node's hot-pixel threshold (RB_THERMAL_HOT_PIXEL_THRESHOLD_DC), for display

hot_region_radius.description: the thermal node's hot-region radius in pixels (1 = 3x3), for display

controller_status.description: Retained rb4107/controller/status payload (also the MQTT Last Will).

controller_log.description: rb4107/controller/log (QoS 0, not retained): the controller's own log lines, as the serial port shows them, in batches; also sent without lines when the log levels change, after reconnecting and every 30 s (docs/logging.md).

dropped.description: lines lost since boot (buffer full, or logged while another line was being copied)

levels.description: "*" = the default level; the other keys are tags set by menuconfig, the console or the dashboard

c4002_gates.description: one entry per distance gate, 1 = enabled; 80 cm resolution only uses the first 15

c4002_thresholds.description: one threshold per distance gate, used with sensitivity custom; 80 cm resolution only uses the first 15

c4002_config.description: Retained rb4107/sensors/<node>/c4002_config: the presence node's C4002 settings, or what happened to the last tuning command (docs/c4002_tuning.md).

request_id.description: of the command answered; 0 = the controller asked on its own

c4002_live.description: rb4107/sensors/<node>/c4002_live (QoS 0, not retained): one raw C4002 result as the sensor reported it, a few per second, for the dashboard's live radar view (docs/c4002_tuning.md). Not used by the safety logic.

results.description: results the node received from the sensor since boot; gaps mean skipped results

target.description: the sensor's own verdict; null = unknown code

presence_gates.description: indices of the gates holding a stationary target; gate i covers i*gate_size_cm to (i+1)*gate_size_cm

c4002_command.description: Dashboard -> controller on rb4107/sensors/<node>/c4002_set (published by Django, not retained). Settings keys are only allowed with action apply; any subset may be sent.

disappear_delay_s.description: how long the radar keeps reporting a target after it leaves; keep small, the S3 does the presence debouncing

lock_time_ds.description: detection paused after occupied -> empty, 0.1 s units

controller_command.description: Dashboard -> controller on rb4107/controller/command (published by Django, not retained). reset = operator reset / acknowledge, as the console's reset command; presence_filter = change the presence filter and the warning/shutdown times until reboot; presence_filter_defaults = back to the menuconfig values; cooking_temp = set the cooking temperature (0.1 degC; cooking when the hottest pixel reaches it), saved on the controller and also sent to the thermal node as its hot-pixel threshold; cooking_temp_defaults = back to the menuconfig value; cookware = pick the cookware profile (mixed, light, heavy, liquid), saved on the controller; cookware_defaults = back to the menuconfig profile; tiers = set temperature tiers 2 to 5 (buzzer and shutdown times for hotter pans; tier 1 is the base times), saved on the controller; tiers_defaults = back to the menuconfig tiers; attendance = set who counts as at the stove (every working radar or either) and the pause budget, saved on the controller; attendance_defaults = back to the menuconfig values; radar_rules = set the radar state and distance rules (mode and episode numbers), saved on the controller; radar_rules_defaults = back to the menuconfig values; params = set every other safety setting (the keys marked params: below, all of them, from firmware/components/rb_params/include/rb_params.def), saved on the controller; params_defaults = back to the menuconfig and built-in values; log_level = set one tag's log level (log_tag, "*" = the default) until reboot, as the console's log command; log_level_defaults = back to the menuconfig log levels (docs/remote_reset.md, docs/logging.md).

shutdown_timing.description: params: Shutdown time counts from (0 = start of UNATTENDED (total unattended time), 1 = start of WARNING)

warning_exit.description: params: Someone comes back during WARNING (0 = return to MONITORING, 1 = stay in WARNING until the person acknowledges (reset input))

cooling_policy.description: params: The pan cools down while unattended (0 = keep the timers running (old behaviour: shuts a cold stove off), 1 = return to IDLE and cancel the timers)

cooking_trend.description: params: Judge from the temperature trend (0 = off, 1 = on)

heat_on_rate_dc_per_min.description: params: Also cooking when rising this fast, 0 = off (dc per min)

heat_off_gap_dc.description: params: Cooking is over this far below the cooking temperature (dc)

fault_shutdown_ms.description: params: FAULT shuts down after, 0 = never (ms)

self_test_timeout_ms.description: params: Self-test result needed within, at boot (ms)

verify_period_ms.description: params: Read back the shutdown output every (ms)

node_stale_ms.description: params: A sensor node is STALE after silence of (ms)

node_offline_ms.description: params: A sensor node is OFFLINE after silence of (ms)

valve_keepalive_ms.description: params: Wireless valve KEEP_OPEN every, under the valve's 3 s (ms)

tier_up_persist_ms.description: params: A hotter tier takes over after holding (ms)

tier_down_persist_ms.description: params: A cooler tier takes over after holding (ms)

tier_hyst_dc.description: params: A cooler tier also needs the pan this far below its threshold (dc)

late_warning_min_ms.description: params: Buzzer before a shutdown that was already due (ms)

tier_rate.description: params: A rising pan gets the tier it is heading for (0 = off, 1 = on)

tier_rate_window_ms.description: params: Rise or fall measured over the last (ms)

trend_min_span_ms.description: params: Trend needs at least this much history (ms)

trend_min_samples.description: params: Trend needs at least this many samples (one per 2 s) (count)

settle_margin_dc.description: params: Cooling margin around the off temperature (dc)

settle_max_drift_dc_per_min.description: params: Prediction may climb this fast to start a cooling hold (dc per min)

settle_exit_drift_dc_per_min.description: params: A cooling hold ends when the prediction climbs faster than (dc per min)

cooling_hold_max_ms.description: params: A cooling hold lasts at most (ms)

cooling_hold_taus_x10.description: params: A cooling hold lasts at most this many time constants (tenths)

warning_min_after_hold_ms.description: params: Buzzer before the shutdown after any hold (ms)

falling_hold.description: params: Hold a due buzzer or shutdown while the pan is falling (0 = off, 1 = on)

falling_rate_dc_per_min.description: params: Falling means at least (dc per min)

falling_hold_max_ms.description: params: A falling hold lasts at most, per countdown (ms)
